boarding_pass.definition: The card or phone screen that lets you board the aircraft. It carries your name, the flight, the gate, the seat and the boarding time.
boarding_pass.example: Show your boarding pass at the gate and find your seat.

cc.definition: A recipient added to an email and shown to everyone, so all readers can see who else has it.
cc.example: I have copied your manager so that she knows the new date.

promise.definition: Something you say you will do. People remember a broken promise for a long time.
promise.example: An promised to tell his mother everything from then on.
